title: All These Worlds
author: Dennis E. Taylor
summary: The third Bobiverse book follows Bob, a former engineer who now lives as software, and his many copies as they spread across space. This time they face threats to humanity and decisions about what a copy owes to the original.
readIf: you like cheerful, geeky science fiction that is more about problem-solving than grim stakes.
skipIf: you have not read the earlier Bob books, as the cast and rules are built up across them.

pairings.reason: Another warm, nerdy story of science used to solve impossible problems.
Same joking, engineer's approach to survival, in a much more contained setting.
An artificial mind with a sarcastic voice, in a much shorter story.
